meta.source: City of Cincinnati 311 Non-Emergency Service Requests
notes: Rates are SUM(on_time) / SUM(evaluable). Never average a percentage.
evaluable counts only requests whose committed date had passed as of the snapshot date. Requests still inside their window are excluded because their outcome is unknown.
Open requests already past their committed date count as misses.
Duplicates are excluded from service-delivery measures and reported separately as an intake measure.
